output.summary: KEP-1381 proposes that kubeadm manage component configs other than its own (kubelet, kube-proxy) without vendoring internal types, defaulting, validation, or conversion code. It is currently implementable at alpha stage.
output.rationale: Kubeadm vendors internal component types and validation/defaulting/conversion code, which blocks moving kubeadm out of kubernetes/kubernetes and can cause false-positive or missed validation errors. Defaulting also fills in fields so users cannot tell which values were intentional. The KEP aims to stop vendoring and defaulting, push validation to component binaries, and distinguish user-supplied from kubeadm-generated configs so unmodified generated configs can be regenerated on format change.

evidence.quote: This cannot continue if kubeadm is to move out of the kubernetes/kubernetes repository.
Defaulting the configs, that are generated by kubeadm or supplied by users, populates additional fields with default values.
Stop vendoring internal types and validation, defaulting and conversion code. - Stop defaulting component configs. - Outsource validation to the component binaries themselves.
Kubeadm generated configs that are not modified by users directly in the config map, can be fully regenerated upon config format change.
